qualification.status: Cubature 1.12.2-0.1.4.0, built for Cleanroom and Forge from a clean checkout of this commit; 263 Cubature tests per loader, 76 Cleanroom and 74 Forge lab tests, 0 failures. riven.ps1 ci passed with this pin. Native runs of fresh Riven worlds: a PREFETCH flight-and-settle, with classes identical to this build but for a renamed parameter in SurfaceHeightUpdates, passed with flight tick p95 36.88 ms and the 20,538-cube settle floor of ab48bdf6, and saved blocks of 82,215 cubes away from spawn matched an ab48bdf6 world; this build passed the lab generation and maintenance contracts. ab48bdf6's storage save scenarios, BASELINE periodic saves and whole-cube sign delivery cover code this commit leaves unchanged.
qualification.contents: Version 0.1.4.0 with Orthrus Research as copyright holder and vendor and compile-only build inputs that a standalone clone fetches; since the initial commit, the manual CI workflow's build-input step, deliveryMode as the only delivery input, the periodic autosave as a named provider call, explicit delivery generation timing with run-or-await for work in flight, sender-chosen PacketCubes sizing, and a provider and lighting that reach the player cube map only through CubeDemand and SurfaceHeightListener.
